relations: Leftward viewpoint drift shifts the orange portal and distant rider toward the right edge until they exit.
As the portal leaves, the curved refractive wall expands to fill a growing share of the image.
The hand and yellow handle, fixed low on the mat, slide toward the lower-right and exit during the pan.
The diagonal wall-ceiling boundary climbs upward across the top as forward motion carries the rider along.
caption: A first-person view from a rider on a mat carries forward through an enclosed water-slide flume. The left side is a curved transparent wall streaked with rainbow-colored light refractions, through which a dim external structure is faintly discernible, while the right side opens into a rippling water channel. A rider's hand grips a looped yellow handle at the bottom of the frame, and far ahead a rectangular tunnel portal glows orange with a second rider visible inside it. The point of view drifts leftward as the rider advances. As the flume carries on, the orange portal and the distant rider slide steadily toward the right edge and leave the frame, so the caustic-covered wall claims an ever larger share of the image. A pale elongated silhouette emerges on the left portion of the wall. The hand and yellow handle shift toward the lower-right corner and leave the frame. The water ripples continuously, and the diagonal line where wall meets ceiling climbs upward across the top of the frame. The forward drift and leftward pan of the view continue without resolution.
